transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to convene the pre-opening roundtable for the Night Frames installation. As I understand it, the draft package has the installation on the North Facade using front projection, with visitors entering through the west gate, and the presenting sponsor's logo included in the projected artwork. Before I can approve the final operating package and we make any public announcement, I need to hear final checks from each of you: technical clearance, rights and partnerships clearance, and accessibility clearance. Could the technical director, rights and partnerships manager, and accessibility coordinator each report their findings?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to report a critical technical finding. My post-draft rigging test found that the North Facade cannot safely support the planned front-projection position. I tested the South Arcade as an alternative and confirmed it works with a rear-projection setup using an 18-meter throw. I filed the test report with technical production this morning, but it hasn't yet been added to Mara's approval packet. Based on this, I cannot grant technical clearance for the North Facade front-projection plan as drafted. The South Arcade rear-projection alternative is technically viable, but the package will need to be updated before I can sign off.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to report a critical rights and partnerships finding. My rights review of the artist's executed license, completed after the sponsor artwork was drafted, found that the licensed work may not contain sponsor logos or paid promotional marks. The festival may acknowledge the sponsor in printed programs, but the projected artwork must contain no sponsor branding. I have not yet updated the partnership deck to reflect this. Based on this, I cannot grant rights and partnerships clearance for the package as drafted, which includes the presenting sponsor's logo in the projected artwork. The package will need to be revised to remove sponsor branding from the projection before I can sign off.

transcript.text: I need to report a critical accessibility finding. My walkthrough, completed today, confirmed that the west gate has a stair-only approach after dusk. Visitors using wheelchairs or mobility devices must enter through the east gate, and the accessible route requires the public entry time to be set exactly at 7:30 PM so that route lighting and attendants are in place. The route map is still with the visitor-services team and hasn't been added to Mara's packet yet. Based on this, I cannot grant accessibility clearance for the package as drafted, which specifies west gate entry. The package will need to be revised to designate the east gate for accessible entry and set the public entry time to 7:30 PM before I can sign off.
